recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP: Set the slide background to solid light gray #E6E6E6. Use a sans-serif font for all text.
2. TITLE BOX (top-left, approx. left 2–20% of slide width, top 4–16% of height): Draw a rectangle with a green border (#008000); fill not captured — use white or no fill. Inside it, type 'Forward Calculations' in bold dark green (#006400), wrapped on two lines ('Forward' / 'Calculations').
3. SLIDE NUMBER (extreme top-right corner): Draw a circle filled yellow (#FFD700) containing the text '34' in black.
4. NEURAL NETWORK DIAGRAM (top-right area, right of the title box, below the slide-number badge):
4a. INPUT (far left of the diagram): Type 'x₁' and 'x₂' in black; to their right draw a column vector — a tall parenthesis/bracket spanning two rows with '1' on top and '5' below, in black.
4b. HIDDEN LAYER (middle of the diagram): Draw three circles stacked vertically, labeled '3', '4', '5' (top to bottom); fill them gold #FFD700 (per-layer fill assignment uncertain — see validation). Place the labels 'O₃', 'O₄', 'O₅' beside the circles in black.
4c. OUTPUT LAYER (right of the hidden layer): Draw two circles labeled '6' (top) and '7' (bottom), filled orange #FFA500 (assignment uncertain — see validation); label them 'O₆' and 'O₇' in black.
4d. TARGET (far right): From O₆ draw a short arrow '→' to '0' and from O₇ an arrow '→' to '1'; render '0' over '1' as a column vector with 't₆' beside '0' and 't₇' beside '1', all in black.
4e. AREA LABELS: Place the word 'Input' above the x₁/x₂ vector, 'Output' above the 6/7 node column, and 'Target' above the 0/1 vector, in black.
4f. BIAS: At the bottom-left of the diagram, draw a node/label 'Bias' in blue (#0000FF).
4g. LEARNING RATE: At the bottom-right of the diagram, type 'η=5' in black.
4h. EDGES: Draw connecting lines from the input vector to each of the three hidden nodes and from each hidden node to each of the two output nodes; add small numeric weight labels on the edges (exact weight values were not captured in the extraction — see validation.uncertain_items).
5. DATA TABLE (bottom two-thirds of the slide): Draw a table with a thick red (#FF0000) outer border, 4 columns × 9 rows: column 1 = row labels; columns 2–4 headed 'O₆', 'O₇', 'Squared Error'. Place each column header inside a green-bordered box (#008000 border) with black text. Row labels top-to-bottom: 'Initial Weights', 'Iteration 1', 'Iteration 2', 'Iteration 3', 'Iteration 4', 'Iteration 5', [ellipsis row], 'Target' — all in black except 'Target', which is bold red (#FF0000).
6. TABLE VALUES — fill the data cells exactly, left to right (O₆, O₇, Squared Error):
- Initial Weights: 0.791, 0.791, 0.669362
- Iteration 1: 0.352, 0.835, 0.151129

- Ellipsis row (between Iteration 5 and Target): blue (#0000FF) '...' in each of the three data columns; row-label cell left empty.
- Target: 0, 1, (leave the Squared Error cell empty).
All values in black.
7. RED ARROW (right side of the table): Draw a large red (#FF0000) downward-pointing block arrow along the right edge of the table, pointing down.
